_doc: Site display settings. Percentile thresholds decide when a stat's title (or its flip) is awarded on a player page.
_min_role_weeks: Reset weeks a player needs in a role (all characters) to be ranked on that role: always on tank, healer and DPS achievements, and on common ones when the role filter is set. Keeps off-specs and short-lived rerolls out of the role rankings.
_min_char_weeks: Reset weeks a character needs to count as a real reroll: below it, it is listed on the player page without its class, gives no class dot next to the player's name and does not count for The Undecided.

home._doc: pinned: cards always shown above the Hall of fame, under the pinned_title heading. A string is an achievement id (left out of the Hall of fame draw, top pinned_top_n shown); an object is a hand-made honour with no stat behind it: title, description and ranked entries {name, image, caption}, image relative to the guild page. ghosts: texts of the Ghosts of Fable section (raiders below the 15 reset weeks cut), visible names before a Show all button. Hall of fame: featured_count achievements drawn at random on each page load. Records: big guild cards built from meta.guild_bosses; `kind` is most_kills, most_wipes, fastest_kill or slowest_kill; `exclude` lists bosses left out of a record (Razorgore: the egg phase is not in the fight length).

player._doc: Player page layout. Overview tiles come first; their stats are left out of the category sections. In each category, up to featured_per_category stats at or above featured_min_pct (or deep in flip territory) get a big card; the rest are small cards, visible_small of them shown before a 'Show more' button. An overview tile shows the percentile bar when its stat is ranked in percentile, unless its `percentile` flag says otherwise. best_friend: texts of the highlighted panel under the overview (players.json friends; {nights} is replaced).
player._section_titles: Ornamented headings of the player page (like Guild Legends on the home page): highlights above the career totals, then one per category section. A missing key shows no heading.
player._highlights: Highlighted career totals under the best friend panel, with a corner band showing the guild rank, coloured like a parse: light gold for #1, then pink 99+, orange 95+, purple 75+, blue 50+, green 25+, grey (percentile under the current filters). A `toggle` adds a switch on the card that switches it to another stat (its label next to the switch, its title on the card).
